INFANTRY.name: Infantry Corps
INFANTRY.description: General-purpose ground forces, strong in occupation and defensive holding.

ARMOR.name: Heavy Armor Division
ARMOR.description: Strong in assault and breakthroughs, weak to anti-armor.

ANTI_ARMOR.name: Anti-Armor Battalions
ANTI_ARMOR.description: Counters armor, weaker in aggressive open assault.

AIRBORNE.name: Airborne Regiments
AIRBORNE.description: Bypasses some fortification effects, strong in maneuver.

ARTILLERY.name: Artillery Batteries
ARTILLERY.description: Increases siege and morale damage, weak in close engagement.

SPECIAL_OPS.name: Special Operations Group
SPECIAL_OPS.description: Targets supply, command, and occupation resistance.

MILITIA.name: Local Militia
MILITIA.description: Weak combat stats but useful for defense and resistance.

ELDER_INFERNOID.name: Elder Infernoid
ELDER_INFERNOID.description: A walking Infernoid war-titan. Small arms cannot reach it; only anti-armor, tanks and guns can, and only in blows that land whole. It occupies nothing — it is sent to break a line, not to hold a street.

PATROL.name: Patrol Craft
PATROL.description: Cheapest hull. Pickets, pirate hunting and customs work.

FRIGATE.name: Frigate
FRIGATE.description: Escort with point defence: shoots down strike craft and torpedoes.

ASSAULT.name: Assault Ship
ASSAULT.description: Armoured troop carrier that boards stations and lands armies under fire.

DESTROYER.name: Destroyer
DESTROYER.description: Line warship built to screen and skirmish.

CRUISER.name: Cruiser
CRUISER.description: Heavy multi-role hull, the fleet's backbone.

CARRIER.name: Carrier
CARRIER.description: Capital hull that fields interceptor and bomber squadrons.

DREADNOUGHT.name: Dreadnought
DREADNOUGHT.description: Flagship. One to a fleet, and the fleet fights around it.

SCOUT.name: Scout
SCOUT.description: Long-range eyes: big sensor reach, sees through fog and spots cloaked ships. Lightly armed.

TORPEDO_BOAT.name: Torpedo Boat
TORPEDO_BOAT.description: Glass cannon: one huge torpedo strike, then mostly spent. Thin armour.

RAIDER.name: Stealth Raider
RAIDER.description: Hidden until it fires. Raids commerce and hunts supply lines.

COMMANDO.name: Commando Ship
COMMANDO.description: Lands agents and commando teams without a full landing; boards stations.

MINELAYER.name: Minelayer
MINELAYER.description: Lays minefields on lanes and chokepoints; sweeps enemy mines.

EWAR.name: Electronic Warfare Ship
EWAR.description: Jams enemy sensors and aim, and hides its fleet’s composition.

TENDER.name: Tender
TENDER.description: A mobile drydock: repairs and refits the fleet far from home.

SUPPLY_SHIP.name: Supply Ship
SUPPLY_SHIP.description: Keeps a fleet or a siege supplied far from home.

INTERDICTOR.name: Interdictor
INTERDICTOR.description: Pins enemy fleets in the system: no retreat, no jump.

HEAVY_CRUISER.name: Heavy Cruiser
HEAVY_CRUISER.description: Fast, hard-hitting, thin-skinned hunter between the cruiser and the battleship.

TROOP_TRANSPORT.name: Troop Transport
TROOP_TRANSPORT.description: Carries whole armies and lands them in force.

SIEGE_SHIP.name: Siege Ship
SIEGE_SHIP.description: Slow and short-ranged, with an enormous bombardment against planets and stations.

COMMAND_SHIP.name: Command Ship
COMMAND_SHIP.description: A flagship below the dreadnought: command bonuses for the fleet, no one-per-fleet limit.

MOBILE_YARD.name: Mobile Shipyard
MOBILE_YARD.description: Builds light hulls wherever it parks.
